svg.title: A function, its first derivative and its second derivative
svg.desc: Three stacked graphs on the same x-axis from minus 2.2 to 2.2. Top: f(x) = x cubed minus 3x (crimson), with level points at (minus 1, 2) and (1, minus 2). Middle: f prime of x = 3x squared minus 3 (blue), which is zero at x = minus 1 and x = 1. Bottom: f double prime of x = 6x (green), the slope of f prime, negative for x below 0 where f prime falls and positive for x above 0 where f prime rises. The third derivative is 6 and the fourth is 0.
svg.text: slope of f; zero at x = ±1,
f′ falls, positive where it rises
